topics: Introduction to Management: Art and science perspectives – External environment
Classical, neo – classical and modern management theories
Levels of managers and skill required
Organization levels and span of control
Leading and Controlling: Leading Vs Managing
Decision Making: Steps, Decision under certainty, risk and uncertainty: Decision trees, EMV method, EOL method, MaxiMin criterion, MiniMaxcriterion, MiniMax regret criterion.
Project Management: Network construction, AON, AOA diagrams
Human resource management: Manpower planning, recruitment, selection, placement, training, development, performance management
Concept of Productivity and its measurement
Market segmentation, Market targeting and product positioning
Product life cycle, Marketing strategies for different stages of product life cycle

partA.description: 2 Questions from each module.  Total of 8 Questions, each carrying 2 marks (8x2 =16marks)

partB.description: 2 questions will be given from each module, out of which 1 question should be answered.  Each question can have a maximum of 2 sub divisions.  Each question carries 6 marks.  (4x6 = 24 marks)

courseOutcomes.description: Develop ability to critically analyse a variety of management practices in the contemporary context
Examine the broad functions of management
Demonstrate ability in decision making and productivity analysis
Apply project management techniques to manage projects
Understand the functional areas of management
Introduce the concept of market, marketing and marketing strategies
